summary: Frontend-only testing of 3 new tasks: (TAREA 1) Volume unit adaptation by Capacity in SessionEditor; (TAREA 2) Combined 'Atleta o Equipo' selector + mass replication; (TAREA 3) Bidirectional drag Calendar->GraphicPlan. CRITICAL BLOCKER FOUND for TAREA 2: the athlete-team-selector is unreachable through normal navigation when an active plan exists. As a consequence, team-mode-badge, graphic-team-mode-banner, and the mass-replication flow CANNOT be exercised by an end user. TAREA 1 (SessionEditor capacity-select) could not be reached through the navigation paths attempted (tab-sesiones / section-tab-periodizacion / its subnavs subnav-period-overview|structure|load). TAREA 3 partially verified: Plan Gráfico renders 24 activities-training cells and Calendar view renders day-cell-* but no gp_* event chips were created because tarea 2 selector is blocked and tarea 3 depends on first creating gp_ events via Plan Gráfico cell-modal with an athlete selected (workflow itself is OK per iter_98).

ui_bugs.issue: athlete-team-selector (and team-mode-badge) live inside the `if (!activeDataSection)` welcome card (DashboardPage.js:1709-1788), but handleSetActivePlan (line 375) forces setActiveDataSection('prev-plan') immediately on plan selection. There is no UI affordance to return to the welcome state without deselecting the plan via 'Cambiar Plan' (which itself clears activePlan, making the selector disappear because it requires activePlan). Result: selector unreachable -> TAREA 2 cannot be used.

integration_issues.issue: Blocked: cannot select a team because the selector renders only in unreachable welcome state. graphic-team-mode-banner consequently never shows. Replication-to-team flow (GraphicPlan.replicateToTeam) was NOT verifiable end-to-end.

Could not verify because no gp_* events existed; calendar rendered day-cell-* OK, drop targets exist. Dependency: first create gp_ event via Plan Gráfico cell modal with an athlete selected; then drag the event-chip-gp_* on calendar. Code path looks consistent (SessionCalendar.handleEventDragStart/handleDrop + DashboardPage.handleEventReschedule) but end-to-end NOT exercised in this run.

Could not reach SessionEditor through the navigation explored. capacity-select-* not present after clicking tab-sesiones nor under section-tab-periodizacion (subnavs: period-overview/structure/load only). Need explicit testid or path documentation to open the SessionEditor modal/panel.

action_items: CRITICAL: Expose the athlete-team-selector OUTSIDE the welcome-only block. Suggested fix: render the selector inside the persistent top-bar of Datos (the same bar where 'Plan Activo' name appears, e.g., DashboardPage.js around line 4322 'CENTER: Section + Sub-section FABs' or in the plan name strip ~lines 60-90), so it is visible across ALL Datos sub-sections (Diagnóstico, Información, Periodización, Plan Gráfico, etc.) whenever activePlan is set. Today it is functionally dead code.
MEDIUM: Add a 'home/back' action that calls setActiveDataSection(null) to allow reaching the welcome card (low-priority workaround; the real fix is exposing the selector globally).

MEDIUM (TAREA 1): Add explicit data-testid or document the path to open SessionEditor so capacity-select-<faseKey>-<idx> can be reached by tests. The PRD mentions 'entrar a Periodización, abrir/crear una sesión' but the periodización dashboard shows only Resumen/Estructura/Carga. Confirm whether the editor is opened from tab-sesiones (top-level) or from a hidden sub-route.
LOW: 404 on resource loading observed multiple times in console (Failed to load resource: 404). Identify and clean.
critical_code_review_comments: DashboardPage.js:1709 — `if (!activeDataSection)` welcome block is the SOLE host of athlete-team-selector (line 1758) and team-mode-badge (line 1783). Combined with line 375 `setActiveDataSection('prev-plan')` on plan select, this guarantees the selector is never rendered in the normal user flow. Move the selector into the persistent top-bar (or render it in every section-render via a shared header component).
DashboardPage.js:1743-1755 — onValueChange uses `v.startsWith('t:')` / `v.startsWith('a:')` correctly; logic is fine.
DashboardPage.js:3913-3923 — teamAthleteIds passed to GraphicPlan only when selectedTeam exists. Since selector is unreachable, this code path is dead for end users.
GraphicPlan.js:2049 — graphic-team-mode-banner correctly gated by teamAthleteIds, but never triggers given the upstream bug.

success_rate.frontend: 20% — Only navigation/topology validated. TAREA 1 not reached (could not open SessionEditor). TAREA 2 BLOCKED by unreachable selector. TAREA 3 only static rendering of Calendar/PlanGrafico verified, drag-back-to-graphic-plan NOT exercised.

seed_data_creation: None. Existing seeds used: team 'gg' (basketball, 3 athletes), team '99' (other, 0 athletes); 9 athletes total; plan 'Plan Deporte General - ATR (Issurin)'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login via 'Iniciar Sesión' button on landing -> form -> tab-planes opens sidebar drawer; click [data-testid^='sidebar-plan-'] to activate. After activation, navigation drops you on section-tab-punto-partida (Diagnóstico -> Plan Anterior). Section tabs available (Datos panel + activePlan): punto-partida, informacion, evaluacion, competencias, periodizacion, visualizacion (Plan Gráfico), herramientas. Subnavs under Periodización: period-overview/structure/load. Subnavs under Visualización: graphic-plan, calendar-view. Subnavs under Información: entities/federation-panel/teams/athletes/sports/tournaments/coaches. KEY BUG: athlete-team-selector only renders when activeDataSection==null, which is impossible while a plan is active (line 375 of DashboardPage forces 'prev-plan'). To exercise TAREA 2 end-to-end the main agent MUST move the selector to a persistent location first.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: visibility gating mismatch. The new TAREA 2 selector was added inside the pre-existing welcome-card render branch (`if (!activeDataSection)`) introduced earlier. When a plan is activated, the code unconditionally jumps to `setActiveDataSection('prev-plan')`, so the welcome branch is bypassed and the selector becomes dead code in the normal user path. Reproduction: 1) login; 2) tab-planes -> sidebar-plan-* -> plan loads with activeDataSection='prev-plan'; 3) tab-datos shows current section (Diagnóstico) not welcome; 4) querySelector('[data-testid="athlete-team-selector"]') returns null in EVERY section reached via the section-tab buttons. Mitigation: extract the selector into a persistent header that renders for all (activePanel='datos' && activePlan) renders, sharing state via the existing selectedAthleteId/selectedTeamId useState in DashboardPage.
